recognition.summary: Hall of Honors recognition covers the first reporter of a new acknowledged vulnerability who cooperates and chooses public credit.

reporting.summary: The disclosure policy documents direct email reporting and requests PGP encryption.

rewards.summary: The reviewed policy establishes recognition without promising a monetary award.

limitations: Testing products in active use, including patient-care equipment, is prohibited.
Philips and Signify have separate disclosure routes; this entry concerns Philips.
